summary: Noah Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K containing its circular for the annual general meeting. The circular covers routine items: re-election of directors, grant of repurchase and issuance mandates, accelerated vesting of RSUs, declaration of final and special dividends, re-appointment of auditor, and adoption of new articles of association. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change is disclosed. As a foreign private issuer filing under Rule 13a-16, this is a routine shareholder meeting notice.
